# Sasha Mindrin (Alexander Mindrin, Саша Миндрин, Александр Миндрин)

> Identity and motion designer based in Tula, Russia. Works with marks, logotypes, brand identity, motion graphics and interactive systems. Available for freelance projects and collaborations.
> Дизайнер айдентики и моушна из Тулы: знаки, логотипы, фирменный стиль, моушн-графика, интерактивные системы. Открыт к фриланс-проектам.

Skills: brand identity, logotype design, motion graphics, web, interactive systems, AI-assisted development, generative imagery and video, illustration, typography, art direction.
Tools: Figma, Adobe Illustrator, After Effects, Cavalry, Blender, Photoshop.

## Selected projects

- [Ba / Ба](https://sashamind.com/ba/) (2026, logo, branding): logo concept for a restaurant built on the model of a Japanese ramen shop, but with Russian soul — shchi instead of ramen, salo instead of wagyu, vodka instead of sake.
- [Tula Marathon / Тульский марафон](https://sashamind.com/tula-marathon/) (2026, logo, motion): logo redesign concept and identity for the Tula Marathon.
- [PuppAI](https://sashamind.com/puppai/) (2026, logo, web, interactive): logo concept for a pet behaviour and health monitoring service.
- [Punk Delicious / Панк делишс](https://sashamind.com/punk-delicious/) (2025, logo, branding): logo and identity concept for a restaurant.
- [Coffee Cult / Кофе культ](https://sashamind.com/coffee-cult/) (2025, logo, illustration): redesign concept for a coffee brand.
- [Strana Sveta / Страна света](https://sashamind.com/strana-sveta/) (2022, motion, art): projection mapping concept for a Saint Petersburg facade, finalist of the Strana Sveta festival.
